description: Create a custom source tag with a name and URL patterns. Research existing tags and cited sources first when recommending changes. Obtain user confirmation before calling. MCP executes immediately after authorization; Athena AI chat presents an approval card. Patterns support hosts (example.com), subdomains (*.example.com), path sections (example.com/blog), exact pages (example.com/blog$), and query constraints (youtube.com/watch?v=abc). Up to 500 patterns; new tags use a neutral color. These are source tags, not prompt tags.

name.description: Custom tag name. Built-in source category names are reserved.

name: create_source_tag
